rows.name: PYTHONCOERCECLOCALE
rows.read_by: Nothing in TRON. `perfetto/test_perfetto.py` sets it for the `perfetto/generate-config` child process.
rows.values: The test sets the fixed text `0`.
rows.effect: One test runs `perfetto/generate-config` (the script that writes a Perfetto trace configuration) with `LC_ALL=C`, `PYTHONCOERCECLOCALE=0` and `PYTHONUTF8=0`. The base configuration file of that test holds non-ASCII text.

new_terms.definition: A program that `nix run .#<name>` starts. `flake.nix` defines the Nix apps `tronperf` and `wrapper` for x86_64 Linux. Each one finds the checkout and starts `perfetto/tronperf` or `perfetto/wrapper`.
A helper function in `t/proxy/test_rzproxy.py`. It builds the environment for the nested pytest runs that the tests start through `t/proxy/run_suite.sh`.
A run of `t/proxy/run_suite.sh` for one test file or one family. The script passes `--replay` to `t/proxy/run_tests.py`.
The file `/etc/positron/dice.yaml`. Its `mode` key selects the host mode (`legacy` or `shared`).
The Python package tool that creates the Python environments outside the Nix dev shell.
A third-party I/O tool. A copy is in `bin/iotools-1.5`. No TRON build file builds it.
The script that starts cargo for the TRON build and lint commands. `CMakeLists.txt`, `GNUmakefile` and `lefthook.yml` call it.

notes: tron_use counts test files as TRON files. PYTEST_CURRENT_TEST and RUNNER_TEMP are 'reads and sets' for that reason: only tests set them. PYTEST_PLUGINS is 'unsets': the helper removes it, and one test sets it in its own process to prove the removal. PYTEST_ADDOPTS is 'sets': two tests pass it into the nested run after the helper removed the inherited value. RUSTC_WRAPPER and RUSTC_WORKSPACE_WRAPPER are 'sets': rust/run-cargo exports them with empty text and does not unset them. Rows of variables that TRON only sets or only removes have an empty default. The three 'unsets' rows also have empty values. TRON code does not depend on the inherited value in these rows. RHOST, RUSER and RM are in group build-tools: all three are make variables of the iotools makefile. PYTEST_CURRENT_TEST: bin/rinzler, bin/runtron and bin/slice use their own copy of the check only when bin/dice is missing or lacks the needed functions. Their copy ignores the override silently, and bin/dice raises an error. The row has no room for this. The evidence quote of flake.nix:557 (row PWD) holds the pipe characters of the source line. No table field holds one. Three facts were checked outside the checkout with scratch files (bash 5.1.16, GNU Make 4.3) and no source line proves them: bash replaces an inherited PWD that does not name the current directory (row PWD), GNU Make keeps an empty environment value for a '?=' variable (row RUSER), and an environment value replaces the built-in RM (row RM). Some cells state the meaning that Python, pytest, cargo or the Nix makeWrapper gives a value: PYTHONCOERCECLOCALE=0, PYTHONUTF8=0, PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1, PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1, PY_COLORS=0, an empty RUSTC_WRAPPER or RUSTC_WORKSPACE_WRAPPER, and 'wrapProgram --set'. The checkout sets these values and does not state their meaning in code. The input records agreed with the code for all 24 variables. No row is dropped.
